name: Carrara (Italy)
description: Navy blue field charged at the centre with a yellow wheel within a ring bearing the motto FORTITVDO MEA IN ROTA (the arms of Carrara).
history: Municipal flag of Carrara, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: wheel within a ring bearing the motto FORTITVDO MEA IN ROTA
